toast.retry_later_one: {n} feed will be checked again in a few minutes
toast.retry_later_other: {n} feeds will be checked again in a few minutes
toast.update_ready: A new version of News is ready
toast.paired_later: Paired – syncing as soon as the server is reachable
toast.no_feeds: Follow a website first – then there’s something to refresh.
toast.cooldown: Just checked – you can check again in a minute

err.invalid_url: That doesn’t look like a web address. Try one starting with https://
err.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
err.unreachable: Can’t reach the server – check the address in Settings.
err.storage_hint: Private windows often block storage – try a normal window.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.count_one: {n} new post – read now, later or not interested?
inbox.count_other: {n} new posts – read now, later or not interested?
inbox.clear_hint: Mark all shown posts as not interested
inbox.empty_text: Follow any website – with or without RSS – and the new posts show up right here.
inbox.empty_how: Every new post gets one decision: Read now opens it, Later saves it for offline reading, Not interested clears it. Everything stays on this device – no account.
inbox.swipe_tip: Tip: swipe a post right for “{right}”, left for “{left}”.

later.title: Later
later.text: Your reading list – on all your devices and ready for offline reading.
later.hint: Tap “Later” on any post in your inbox to save it here.

dismissed.title: Not interested
dismissed.text: Posts you skipped. Changed your mind? Send one back to the inbox.

feeds.title: Feeds
feeds.follow_text: Paste a feed or any web page – RSS or not, News finds the posts.
feeds.shared: Link received – tap Follow to subscribe.
feeds.unfollow_body: {title} disappears from all your devices. Posts you saved for later stay in your list.
feeds.io_text: Coming from another reader? Import its OPML file. Once News is installed on Android, you can also add sites from the share menu. On desktop, drag this button to your bookmarks bar:
feeds.import_nothing_one: Nothing new – you already follow that feed.
feeds.import_nothing_other: Nothing new – you already follow all {n} feeds.
feeds.folder_text: Put {title} in a folder: pick one or type a new name. Leave it empty to take it out again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: News {version} · your data stays on your devices – the server only ever sees encrypted data.
settings.swipe_text: Choose what happens when you swipe a post. Touch screens only; saved on this device.
settings.server_text: News fetches your feeds and syncs through this server. Leave the default, or enter the address of your own News Reader server.
settings.test_wrong: Something answered, but it isn’t a News Reader server.
settings.test_fail: Can’t connect. Check the address, the HTTPS certificate and your internet connection.
settings.sync_paired: This device is paired. Scan the code with your phone (or open the link on another device) to share feeds, reading list and progress. There’s no account – whoever has the link gets in, so keep it to yourself.
settings.sync_intro: News works fully offline on this device. Want your feeds on your phone or another browser too? Set up sync. Everything is encrypted right here before it leaves – the server only stores a file it can’t read. No account, no e-mail, no password.
settings.sync_https: Sync needs a secure connection (HTTPS) – this page isn’t using one.
settings.join_title: Already using News on another device?
settings.join_text: Scan its QR code, or paste its pairing link or key here.
settings.join_invalid: That’s neither a pairing link nor a sync key.
settings.keys_text: Speech input or a stray key press can trigger single-key shortcuts. Turn them off here if they get in your way.
settings.key_arrows: next / previous once a post is selected

dlg.clear_done_body_one: {n} finished post will be removed. It won’t come back to your inbox.
dlg.clear_done_body_other: {n} finished posts will be removed. They won’t come back to your inbox.
dlg.unpair_body: This device stops syncing. Everything stays on it, and your other devices keep syncing as before.
dlg.wipe_body:
Your encrypted sync data is removed from the server. Your devices keep everything; the next time a paired device syncs, it uploads its copy again.

Want it gone for good? Unpair every device first.
dlg.reset_body: Removes all feeds, reading states and saved posts from this browser. Your synced data on the server stays untouched – pair again to get it back.
dlg.pair_body: This device will share feeds, reading list and progress with all your paired devices.
dlg.pair_leave: It will stop syncing with its current devices.
dlg.pair_merge: What’s already on this device is merged in – nothing gets lost.

sync.local_long: Not paired – everything stays on this device
sync.unreachable_long: The server can’t be reached right now
sync.https: Sync needs a secure connection (HTTPS) for encryption.
sync.conflict: Lots of changes at once – trying again in a moment.
sync.decrypt: Can’t unlock your sync data – the key is wrong or the data is damaged.
sync.format: The server holds sync data in an unknown format.

devices.title: Paired devices
devices.text: Every device that syncs with this one. Names are stored encrypted – the server never sees them.
devices.none: The list fills after the first sync.
devices.rename_prompt: Name for this device, e.g. “Phone” or “Work laptop”
devices.remove_body: {name} is locked out: News creates a new key, your other devices switch to it automatically, and old pairing links stop working. The removed device keeps what it has already downloaded.
devices.removed_self_body: Another device removed this one from sync. Everything stays here; pair again to keep syncing.
devices.keyless_one: {n} device hasn’t synced since the last update and will have to pair again.
devices.keyless_other: {n} devices haven’t synced since the last update and will have to pair again.
devices.rotate_body: Creates a new key. Paired devices switch automatically; old pairing links and QR codes stop working. Use it if a pairing link got into the wrong hands.
devices.rotated: New key active – old pairing links no longer work
devices.stale_link_title: This pairing link is no longer valid
devices.stale_link_body: The key was changed on another device. Ask for a new pairing link or QR code.
devices.key_changed: Key changed – this device won’t get the next key. Remove it and pair it again.

reader.unavailable: You’re offline, and this article wasn’t saved for offline reading.
reader.partial: Only part of this article could be saved – the page is behind a paywall or built with JavaScript.

ctx.rarely: less than one post a week

errc.no_feed: We couldn’t find any posts on this page. Try the site’s blog or news page, or its feed address.
errc.platform: This platform doesn’t offer feeds, so News can’t follow it.
errc.dns: This address doesn’t exist – check for typos.
errc.upstream: The site isn’t answering right now. Try again later.
errc.blocked: This site doesn’t let News fetch its feed. Ask whoever runs it to allow it, or try another source.
errc.too_large: This page is too big to read.
errc.redirects: The site keeps redirecting – try a more specific address.
errc.invalid: News can’t open this kind of address.
errc.busy: Lots going on – try again in a minute.
errc.sync_disabled: Sync is turned off on this server.
errc.network: Sync isn’t available from your network.
errc.full: This server isn’t taking new sync setups right now.
errc.sync_too_big: Your sync data is too big for this server.
errc.misconfigured: The server isn’t set up correctly – tell whoever runs it.
errc.no_article: There’s no readable article on this page.
errc.generic: Something went wrong. Try again later.
